title: Pay with a gift card at checkout

acceptance_criteria.text: A gift card code is 16 characters: letters A-Z and digits only.
The gift card pays as much of the order total as its balance allows; any remainder is paid by card.
A gift card with a zero balance shows "This gift card has no balance".
An unknown or badly formed code shows "Gift card code not recognised".
The gift card should be applied quickly.
